BigQueryHook: apache-airflow-providers-google: the hook class a DAG reaches BigQuery through
Client: google-cloud-bigquery: the class the library hands a project to run a job
bigquery: BigQuery: the SQL dialect its statements are written in, as @suss/sql names it
configuration: apache-airflow-providers-google: the keyword BigQueryHook.insert_job takes a whole job configuration under
delete_table: google-cloud-bigquery and apache-airflow-providers-google: the call that removes a table
destination: google-cloud-bigquery: the keyword the load_table_from_* calls take the table they write under
get_client: apache-airflow-providers-google: the BigQueryHook call that hands back the client library's own Client
get_first: apache-airflow-providers-google: the BigQueryHook call that runs a statement and returns its first row
get_pandas_df: apache-airflow-providers-google: the BigQueryHook call that runs a statement and returns a dataframe
get_records: apache-airflow-providers-google: the BigQueryHook call that runs a statement and returns its rows
get_table: google-cloud-bigquery: the call that reads a table's metadata
insert_job: apache-airflow-providers-google: the BigQueryHook call that submits a job configuration, with the statement inside it
insert_rows: google-cloud-bigquery: the call that streams rows into a table
insert_rows_json: google-cloud-bigquery: the call that streams JSON rows into a table
list_rows: google-cloud-bigquery: the call that reads a table's rows
load_table_from_dataframe: google-cloud-bigquery: the call that loads a dataframe into a table
load_table_from_file: google-cloud-bigquery: the call that loads a file into a table
load_table_from_json: google-cloud-bigquery: the call that loads JSON rows into a table
load_table_from_uri: google-cloud-bigquery: the call that loads objects at a URI into a table
query: google-cloud-bigquery: the Client call that runs a statement, and the keyword it takes the statement under
query_and_wait: google-cloud-bigquery: the Client call that runs a statement and waits for its rows
run_query: apache-airflow-providers-google: the older BigQueryHook call that runs a statement
sql: apache-airflow-providers-google: the keyword the BigQueryHook statement calls take the statement under
table: google-cloud-bigquery: the keyword the table calls take the table they work on under
table_id: apache-airflow-providers-google: the keyword BigQueryHook.delete_table takes the table under
